grammar.title: Informal passive with 叫/让
grammar.pattern: 受事 + 叫/让 + 施事 + 动词 + 其他成分
grammar.explanation: In casual speech, 叫 (jiào) and 让 (ràng) can work just like 被 to mark a passive sentence — the subject has something done to it by someone else. This is common in everyday conversation, while 被 sounds more formal or written.

grammar.title: Starting to with 形容词/动词 + 起来
grammar.explanation: 起来 (qǐlái) after an adjective or verb can mark the start of a new state — "start to become, get into doing". Unlike its literal sense of standing up, here it shows a change beginning and continuing.

sentences.zh: 为了参加比赛，他每天练习。
sentences.pinyin: Wèile cānjiā bǐsài, tā měi tiān liànxí.
sentences.en: In order to take part in the competition, he practices every day.

sentences.pinyin: Lián wǒ dōu bù zhīdào zhè jiàn shì.
sentences.en: Even I don't know about this.

sentences.pinyin: Tā lián yī jù huà dōu méi shuō.
sentences.en: He didn't even say a single word.

sentences.zh: 连老师都不知道这个问题。
sentences.pinyin: Lián lǎoshī dōu bù zhīdào zhège wèntí.
sentences.en: Even the teacher doesn't know this question.

sentences.zh: 他忙得连饭都没时间吃。
sentences.pinyin: Tā máng de lián fàn dōu méi shíjiān chī.
sentences.en: He's so busy he doesn't even have time to eat.

sentences.zh: 只有多练习，才能说好汉语。
sentences.pinyin: Zhǐyǒu duō liànxí, cái néng shuō hǎo Hànyǔ.
sentences.en: Only with lots of practice can you speak Chinese well.

sentences.zh: 只有你告诉我，我才能知道。
sentences.pinyin: Zhǐyǒu nǐ gàosu wǒ, wǒ cái néng zhīdào.
sentences.en: Only if you tell me can I know.

sentences.pinyin: Zhè jiàn shì shǐ wǒ hěn nánguò.
sentences.en: This matter made me very sad.
Anyone at all can take part.

sentences.pinyin: Rènhé wèntí tā dōu néng huídá.

sentences.zh: 任何时候你都可以给我打电话。
sentences.pinyin: Rènhé shíhou nǐ dōu kěyǐ gěi wǒ dǎ diànhuà.

sentences.en: This question is decided by the teacher.
I'll be the one to make dinner.

sentences.pinyin: Zhè shì wǒ suǒ zhīdào de yīqiè.
